# 🧩 Documentation and Engineering Templates

Use these templates to make project changes reviewable and evidence-based. Remove instructional prompts when completing a template.

| Template | Use |
|---|---|
| [ADR](adr-template.md) | Record an architectural decision |
| [Architecture](architecture-template.md) | Describe system components and boundaries |
| [API documentation](api-documentation-template.md) | Document an API if one is introduced |
| [Database schema](database-schema-template.md) | Describe data entities if a database is introduced |
| [Feature specification](feature-specification-template.md) | Define a learning feature |
| [Bug report](bug-report-template.md) | Reproduce a defect |
| [QA test case](qa-test-case-template.md) | Record a manual test |
| [Test plan](test-plan-template.md) | Plan verification |
| [Test report](test-report-template.md) | Record actual results |
| [Threat assessment](threat-assessment-template.md) | Assess security risks |
| [Security audit](security-audit-template.md) | Record security review evidence |
| [Accessibility audit](accessibility-audit-template.md) | Record accessibility findings |
| [Incident report](incident-report-template.md) | Document an incident |
| [Release checklist](release-checklist.md) | Prepare a release |
| [Deployment checklist](deployment-checklist.md) | Verify static publication |
| [Rollback checklist](rollback-checklist.md) | Plan a source rollback |
| [Migration](migration-template.md) | Plan a file or behavior migration |
| [Risk assessment](risk-assessment-template.md) | Track project risks |
| [Change request](change-request-template.md) | Propose a controlled change |
| [Code review](code-review-template.md) | Review a contribution |
| [Project status](project-status-template.md) | Report current state |
| [Meeting notes](meeting-notes-template.md) | Capture project decisions |
| [Maintenance checklist](maintenance-checklist.md) | Run routine maintenance |

Templates do not mean the corresponding process or subsystem currently exists. In particular, API and database templates are reserved for future architectural changes.
